Portfolio

Projects

PIC16F887 🌡
Automatic Car Climate Control System

Closed-loop HVAC system with ADC-based temperature feedback driving PWM-controlled fan, heater, and AC relays. Modular firmware ensures clean actuator state transitions; validated via MPLAB X IDE and in-circuit testing.

Embedded C ADC PWM Closed-Loop MPLAB X
STM32F103C6T6 🚿
Automatic Restroom Cleaning System

Interrupt-driven sensor fusion detects occupancy and triggers timed water-spray and disinfectant cycles. PWM-controlled solenoid valves provide precise flow duration; validated across 200+ duty cycles.

Keil µVision Interrupts PWM Sensor Fusion
ESP32-CAM · FreeRTOS 🤖
IoT Off-Terrain Adventure Robot

Concurrent real-time video streaming and bidirectional motor control over Wi-Fi via a browser dashboard. FreeRTOS task scheduling eliminates frame drops under high motor load; L298N H-bridge enables differential steering.

FreeRTOS Wi-Fi Video Stream L298N PWM
PIC16F887 🏢
Lift Control System

Multi-floor elevator logic with keypad floor selection, LCD display, and DC motor direction control. Door-interlock safety logic prevents movement during open state. Firmware structured as a clean state machine (IDLE / MOVING / DOOR-OPEN).

Embedded C State Machine Safety Interlock LCD
STM32 · GSM 🔐
Theft Alert System

ARM Cortex-M3 intrusion detection via PIR sensor with instant GSM SMS alerts through SIM800L. STOP mode with EXTI wake reduces power by ~60%; software debounce prevents false-positive flooding.

PIR GSM/SIM800L AT Commands Low Power EXTI
ESP32 ⚡
Wireless EV Charging System

ESP32-based wireless EV charging controller with real-time communication and power management. Integrates inductive charging principles with embedded firmware for efficient energy transfer monitoring and control.

ESP32 Wireless Power Management IoT
